title: its OKAY-at best
text:
its OKAY-at best. I wanted to have filtered water IceCubes that had a lid. This seemed nifty. There are a few issues with it though.
1) the lid doesn't snap on. you kind of have to use your finger nails to push the canister under the lid to be sure its closed completely (not leak proof-must stay up right).
2) you cannot fill water past the first ring of bubbles because it will overflow. i fill it approx 2/3rds full on the first bible ring.
3) the inside canister creates a circle of ice at the bottom because it cannot fit completely down. So you get a hocky puck under the blue insert, plus the majority of the little ice bubble shapes from around the cylinder. its not a bad thing but it can be frustrating because i have to use the end of a knife or mallet to break the solid circle of ice if i want to use it.

over all, it IS better than ice trays, but its not perfect. for $20, i'll keep it.
